title: Show HN: Airbyte Agents – context for agents across multiple data sources
summary: Airbyte launches Agents, leveraging their 6 years of data connector expertise to create a unified data layer that enables AI agents to discover information and take actions across multiple operational systems like Slack, Salesforce, and Linear.
problem_solved: Eliminates complex API plumbing when connecting AI agents to multiple business tools and data sources.
why_valuable: Provides agents with unified, contextual access to disparate data sources, accelerating real-world AI workflow deployment.
